sections.Profile:
"Gizmo" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Manufacturing Company on August 4, 1948. Designed by Harry Williams and Sam Stern, the game features four flippers, nine passive bumpers, and five kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Aviation, Single Player, Wood Rail, Original Theme, Beach
